sent_bad: Nintendo has not officially announced any follow-up to the current Switch, so everything here is rumor-based.

Meanwhile, Nintendo's president Shuntaro Furukawa confirmed in an interview with Nikkei that Nintendo will support the current-gen Switch until at least March 2025, which is consistent with a 2025 transition.

Given that the next console may arrive as early as March 2025 and Nintendo is supporting the current Switch until at least that point, the document's overall advice is to wait for an official announcement before holding your breath — or, in your case, before committing to the OLED model.
